title: Aureline M5 AI review scope selector
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a review scope selector. Names the object class, its review association, the analyzed diff scope, the repo instruction and enabled check source that bound it, whether the diff or instruction source has drifted, and the rerun recommendation that keeps findings joined to the diff they were produced from — so a finding never silently outlives the diff scope it was bound to. Downstream review detail, the AI review panel, the review scope selector, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a scope by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
